## Release triplet

- **shell:** 0.1.2
- **backend tested against:** upstream `master` @ `c291e79` (`0.1.5-rc.2`)
- **bundled dsh-browser:** 0.1.0 (`dsh.engines.backend >=0.1.5-rc.1`)

## Install

Requires Git, Node.js 22+, and pnpm on PATH (first-run provisioning and
backend updates shell out to them).

Download `dsh-desktop_0.1.2_x64-setup.exe` below, run it (per-user, no
admin), and launch. First run offers **Install bundled dsh**
(recommended — clones upstream, installs, builds) or **Use my own dsh**
(your checkout, your updates, the shell never touches it).

Unsigned build: Windows SmartScreen shows an "unknown publisher"
click-through on first install. Signing is a later milestone.
